briefs.title: keepup · week of 31 Aug
briefs.body:
**What shipped that touches this product**

1. Chats with no model set stop working on 23 Oct, and this moves the default to OpenAI's named substitute. · keeps working · vendor claim · effort: hours
   gpt-4.1-nano, your OpenAI default, shuts down on 23 Oct (announced 22 Apr) (1 Sep): Move the OpenAI default to gpt-5.6-luna, OpenAI's named substitute. With no model set, chats fall back to gpt-4.1-nano (server/models/systemSettings.js:878 at this base). [Source](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations)
   → pull request not opened yet

2. Audio uploads that use OpenAI would stop working on 26 Feb 2027, when OpenAI shuts down the model they use, so this moves them to its replacement and makes the model something you can change in settings. · keeps working · vendor claim · effort: hours
   OpenAI announces whisper-1 shuts down on 26 Feb 2027 (announced 26 Aug) (1 Sep): Move OpenAI audio uploads to gpt-transcribe before whisper-1 shuts down. [Source](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/changelog)
   → pull request not opened yet

**Checked and held back**

- GPT-6 Astra: tool calling requires the Responses API (3 Sep): Already handled: your OpenAI agent provider has called tools through the Responses API since 1 Oct 2025

Nothing else new for this product this week · 1,676 new or updated across AI
